Message:
tracing: Make TRACE_ITER_STOP_ON_FREE stop the correct buffer

Releasing the free_buffer file in an instance causes the global buffer
to be stopped when TRACE_ITER_STOP_ON_FREE is enabled. Operate on the
correct buffer.
